story.festival_blossoms.name: Blossom festival
story.festival_blossoms.desc: A blossom-festival challenge: plant twenty-five plants.
story.festival_blossoms.ch.c1.sum: Spring is here somewhere. Plant twenty-five seeds, saplings or plants.
story.festival_blossoms.r1.start: A blossom festival is on! Petals are falling like snow. Plant twenty-five things — seeds, saplings, flowers — and your base gets flower pots.
story.festival_blossoms.graduated: Everything is in bloom. Flower pots and seeds for your garden.
story.festival_blossoms.d1.start: Plant twenty-five seeds, saplings or plants.
story.festival_blossoms.d1.done: Twenty-five plants in the ground. Spring has arrived at your base.
